proofCommands: Manual EduTool.dev ZIP/log audit saved under verification-output/edutool-audit-loop/20260620T030228Z/

claims.summary: Quick evidence checks, exit tickets, and practice responses classify as in-class unless they carry an explicit grade percentage.
Assessment reconciliation skips zero-weight in-class checks instead of requiring standalone artifacts for them.
High-stakes missing artifacts and low-stakes unknown assessment promises remain visible through the existing warning/info paths.
Focused tests pin the audited Psychology shape: weighted evidence checks stay graded while quick/exit/practice checks stay in-class.

carryForward.next: After Pages deploy, run the EduTool.dev audit loop again and confirm whether the same Psychology prompt reaches 100/100 with no digest caveat.
Consider a column-schema/UI label that distinguishes submitted assessments from classroom formative checks.
